{{Quote|I had left to join another clan, to follow a lover. ''[...]'' His name was Zadik Lone. When we learned the Empire had betrayed my clan, I told Zadik to rally his people to defend them. '''Zadik Lone''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who was active around the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The man I was with when my people fell... his clan lost all honor after I left. They joined Clan Rook. My old lover dishonors the name Mandalorian. That coward dies with the rest of Rook's filth.|[[Akaavi Spar]]|<ref name="TOR:CR" />}}
A member of [[Clan Lone]], Zadik eventually met and fell in love with fellow Mandalorian [[Akaavi Spar]]. Spar left [[Clan Spar|her clan]] to join Lone's so they could be together. When the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire moved against Spar's clan, she pleaded with Zadik Lone to rally his clan to come to their defense, but they refused to take action. Disgusted, Spar abandoned Lone and his clan to seek out justice for her people.<ref name="TOR:ZL" />

When word of Clan Lone's refusal to aid a fellow clan spread, Lone and his clan were disgraced, and eventually came to join the [[Clan Rook/Legends|criminal contingent]] of [[Tayari Rook]], a false Mandalorian and the very one responsible for Clan Spar's downfall. Lone and Rook's people later came under attack by Akaavi Spar on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], after the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] female had learned the truth about her clan's demise. Any who didn't flee the encampment when she began her assault were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR:CR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zadik Lone was first introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="TOR:ZL" />
